policy: No user-facing numeric claim is permitted without a validated canonical qualification artifact.

claims.claim_text: The retained frozen M0 baseline achieved 66.64% exact match on all 1,319 protected GSM8K test examples.
claims.qualification: Evaluator-only v3 rescore of complete, hash-frozen v2 generation outputs; exact normalized numeric/string matching.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not call this symbolic mathematical accuracy or claim independent v3 model generation.

claims.claim_text: A rank-32 attention+MLP LoRA challenger was rejected after protected GSM8K exact match fell from 66.64% to 49.43% (-17.21 pp; paired 95% bootstrap CI [-20.24, -14.18]).
claims.qualification: All 1,319 paired GSM8K test examples; 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples; deterministic frozen v2 outputs re-scored by the corrected v3 parser.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not claim LoRA improved quality or that the result generalizes beyond this checkpoint, prompt, parser, and dataset.

claims.claim_text: The LoRA challenger also regressed on the complete MATH-500 OOD check: 18.80% versus 29.80% for M0 (-11.00 pp; paired 95% CI [-14.80, -7.00]).
claims.qualification: All 500 MATH-500 examples; conservative normalized final-answer exact match, not symbolic equivalence.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not describe 29.80% as canonical MATH-500 accuracy or claim symbolic-equivalence evaluation.
